svg.aria-label: Light goes into the LUZ prism and comes out as three bands, one per package: @luz-ds/catalog, site-wide pieces and page patterns; @luz-ds/core, bare HTML, layout and components; @luz-ds/tokens, tokens, colour modes and the font. Catalog needs core and tokens; core needs tokens.
svg.title: Light goes into the LUZ prism and comes out as three bands, one per package: @luz-ds/catalog, site-wide pieces and page patterns; @luz-ds/core, bare HTML, layout and components; @luz-ds/tokens, tokens, colour modes and the font. Catalog needs core and tokens; core needs tokens.
